title: 🎉 MP3WAP v2.0 Launched!
content:
We're excited to announce the launch of MP3WAP v2.0! This major update brings:

• Enhanced WAP-style retro design
• New folder system to organize your music
• Real-time activity feed showing latest updates
• Improved search functionality
• Better mobile experience

Start exploring and upload your favorite tracks today!

title: 📢 New Feature: Folder Organization
content:
You can now create folders to organize your MP3 collection! Group songs by genre, artist, or any category you like. Simply go to the Folders section to create and manage your folders.

Uploaded songs can be assigned to a folder for easy browsing.

title: 📊 Site Milestone: 100 Downloads!
content:
We've reached 100 total downloads! Thank you to all our users for your support. Keep uploading and sharing your favorite music with the community.

Stay tuned for more features coming soon!
